name: Cremations
overview: Scripture acknowledges that the human body returns to dust after death, as stated in Genesis 3:19, emphasizing the physical reality of mortality. While the Bible records instances of burning bodies, such as in Joshua 7:25 and Amos 2:1, these actions are often associated with judgment or punishment rather than prescribed burial practices. Ultimately, the hope of believers lies not in the state of the earthly body but in the resurrection, where Christ will transform our lowly bodies into glorious ones, as affirmed in Philippians 3:21, and gather His elect from all corners of the earth, as described in Mark 13:27.
